features.name: Paladin Starting Proficiencies
features.description:
As a paladin, you gain the following proficiencies:

**Armor:** All armor, shields
**Weapons:** Simple weapons, martial weapons
**Saving Throws:** Wisdom, Charisma
**Skills:** Choose two from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, and Religion

choices.name: First Skill
choices.description: Choose one from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, or Religion.

choices.name: Second Skill
choices.description: Choose another from Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Medicine, Persuasion, or Religion.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description:
The presence of strong evil registers on your senses like a noxious odor, and powerful good rings like heavenly music in your ears. As an action, you can open your awareness to detect such forces. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet of you that is not behind total cover.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier. When you finish a long rest, you regain all expended uses.

payload.name: Divine Sense
payload.description: Detect celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 ft (not behind total cover) until end of your next turn. Also detects consecrated/desecrated places.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description:
Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power equal to your paladin level × 5. As an action, you can touch a creature and restore hit points from the pool.

Alternatively, expend 5 HP from the pool to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. Multiple diseases/poisons can be cured with a single use.

No effect on undead and constructs. Pool refills on a long rest.

payload.name: Lay on Hands
payload.description: Touch a creature to restore HP from pool (paladin level × 5). Or spend 5 HP to cure a disease/poison.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: At 2nd level, you adopt a style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of: Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, or Protection.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
By 2nd level, you have learned to draw on divine magic through meditation and prayer to cast spells as a cleric does. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier
**Spell attack modifier** = your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier

You prepare a number of paladin spells equal to your Charisma modifier + half your paladin level (rounded down, minimum 1). You can change your prepared spells after a long rest. You can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

features.name: Divine Health
features.description: By 3rd level, the divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.description:
When you reach 3rd level, you swear the oath that binds you as a paladin forever. Choose the Oath of Devotion, the Oath of the Ancients, or the Oath of Vengeance.

Your choice grants you features at 3rd level and again at 7th, 15th, and 20th level. Those features include oath spells and the Channel Divinity feature.

Oath spells: You always have these prepared, and they don't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

Channel Divinity: You must finish a short or long rest to use Channel Divinity again after using it. Save DC = your paladin spell save DC.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

choices.name: Ability Score Improvement
choices.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (with a minimum bonus of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 8)
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

choices.name: Ability Score Improvement
choices.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description:
Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious.

At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.description: By 11th level, you are so suffused with righteous might that all your melee weapon strikes carry divine power with them. Whenever you hit a creature with a melee weapon, the creature takes an extra 1d8 radiant damage. If you also use your Divine Smite with an attack, you add this damage to the extra damage of your Divine Smite.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 12)
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

choices.name: Ability Score Improvement
choices.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.description:
Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (a minimum of once). You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

payload.name: Cleansing Touch
payload.description: End one spell on yourself or on a willing creature you touch.
